sentences.en: I'm interested in economics, and in addition, I want to study politics.
sentences.zh: 我对经济学感兴趣，另外还想学习政治学。

sentences.en: We will have a meeting tomorrow morning, in addition, there is an evening party.

sentences.en: She has two cats, and in addition to them, she also has three dogs.
sentences.zh: 她有两只猫，另外还有三只狗。
